    # Standard next-lexicographic-permutation algorithm:
    # 1. Find the rightmost index i where a[i] < a[i+1] (the pivot).
    # 2. If no pivot exists, the list is the last permutation -> return sorted list.

    a = list(nums)
    n = len(a)
    i = n - 2
    while i >= 0 and a[i] >= a[i + 1]:
        i -= 1
    if i >= 0:
        j = n - 1
        while a[j] <= a[i]:
            j -= 1
        a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
    a[i + 1:] = reversed(a[i + 1:])
    return a
